# Travel policy

Book flights at least 14 days ahead. Economy class for trips under 6 hours. Hotels up to $220 a night in tier-1 cities. Submit receipts within 30 days.

# Expense policy

Meals are reimbursed up to $75 a day. Client dinners need a manager's approval in advance. Mileage is paid at the federal rate.

# Onboarding

New hires get a laptop on day one, meet their buddy in week one and finish security training within 10 days.

# Benefits

Health cover starts on the first day. The 401(k) match is 4%. Parental leave is 16 weeks.

# Deploying

Deploys go out Tuesday and Thursday. Run the smoke suite before promoting a build. Rollbacks use the previous image tag.

# On-call

The on-call rotation is weekly and hands over on Monday at 10:00. Page the secondary after 15 minutes without an acknowledgement.

# Notes 2026-11-02

Decided to move the billing service to the new cluster in December.

# Notes 2026-11-05

The Orion migration slipped a week because of the vendor contract.

"""Refunds."""
from billing.ledger import Ledger


def refund(ledger: Ledger, customer, amount):
    ledger.post("receivables:" + customer, -amount)

from billing.invoice import Invoice
from billing.ledger import Ledger


def test_issue_posts_total():
    ledger = Ledger()
    total = Invoice("acme", "TX", [(100.0, 2)]).issue(ledger)
    assert ledger.balance("receivables:acme") == total
